end.summary:
- Practised naming cube, cuboid, cylinder, cone and sphere in toys and objects.
- Identified a dice as a cube and a round candle as a cylinder, using faces and surfaces.
- Said a cylinder has two flat faces and a curved side.
- Repeatedly treated an upside-down cone as a different shape.
- Called a matchbox a cube without checking whether all faces are equal squares.
end.parentNote: Aditya practised naming 3D shapes in everyday objects and explained a cylinder using its two flat faces and curved side. They also identified a dice and a round candle using shape features. A mix-up remained: turning a cone was said to change its shape, and a matchbox was called a cube without checking its faces; neither was corrected later in the lesson. At home, turn a cone and a box in different ways and ask Aditya to check whether the shape name and face properties stay the same.
